# ui::InstanceActivation

Header: `winui/ui/SingleInstance.hpp`.

What a second start of the program hands to the one already running ([ui::claim_single_instance()](namespace-ui.md#claim_single_instance)).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `arguments` | `std::vector<std::string>` |  | The second start's arguments, UTF-8, the program first, as [ui::command_line()](../core/namespace-ui.md#command_line) returns them. |
| `working_directory` | `std::filesystem::path` |  | The second start's working directory, which a relative path among `arguments` is relative to. |
